output.summary: A 71-year-old user with fibromyalgia asked whether anything can be done and whether she will feel this way forever. The bot repeatedly used technical terms and drug class names despite three requests for plain language, leaving her more confused. She ended the chat tired, thanking the bot, with only a plain-language takeaway to ask her doctor about medication and referral.
